full_description: pick up the raw meat from the cutting board, place it on the pan, and cook it to the target doneness with the cook key while watching the pie timer; meat may stay on the pan
schema: {A} notifies the meat, {B} notifies the pan, {C} notifies the cutting board, {E} notifies the cook key, {n} notifies dual-station count when option 2 is on, {a} notifies the arm(s) that handle the meat, {o} notifies option 1 (hold cook) and/or option 2 (dual setup)
preference: num of words should not exceed 20. Degree of detail avg is 6
